messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — I'm proposing we run outreach in 3 waves for the design-ally beta. Wave 1: 10 high-touch partners. Wave 2: 25 semi-managed. Wave 3: open invite (waitlist). Goals: surface 5 signal patterns, validate rollout hooks, and get 2 case studies.
Jordan Li: Sounds reasonable. For wave timing, can we do 2 weeks between waves? short cadence helps iterate prompts + SDK changes.
Sonia Rivera: +1 on cadence. Also recommend we require a short tech check (3 items) before invite: infra contact, data policy ok, primary use-case. Keeps churn low.
Ken Cho: Agree. What's the acceptance criteria for moving from wave1->wave2? e.g., <20% dropouts, avg latency within SLA on sample routes, and 3 positive qualitative interviews.
Maya Patel: Draft criteria: 
- 80% of partners complete onboarding tasks within 5 days
- At least 3 integrations hitting real traffic (non-demo)
- No critical regression flagged by automated evals
If all met -> scale to wave2.
Jordan Li: For feedback loops: daily async check-ins in a thread + weekly 30m calls for wave1. For wave2, biweekly calls. Use a shared Google Sheet + structured prompt-eval set.
Sonia Rivera: We should instrument a 6-question pulse after first week: NPS-like, task completion, blockers, suggestions, perceived accuracy, willingness to recommend. BetaBot: Poll created: "Design Ally week1 pulse" — link https://docs.redwood/pulses/1718529630
Ken Cho: Outreach template looks good but tighten the ask. Suggest DM template snippet:
```
Hi <name> — we'd love to invite you to a short 4-week "design ally" beta. We'll provide support and prefer teams building >1k monthly active prompts. If interested reply YES and share your infra contact.
```
Maya Patel: Love that. Also, let's add a clause about privacy: "no PII shared" and optional NDA for high-touch partners.
Sonia Rivera: Can Ops support rolling 2 dedicated seats for wave1? Need them to test Dedicated config + metrics export.
Jordan Li: Ops confirmed 2 seats for May 10 start — can we gate invites until infra is wired?
Maya Patel: Yes. Action items:
- Jordan: finalize onboarding checklist + SDK snippet (due Tue)
- Sonia: draft pulse survey and consent language (due Tue)
- Ken: outreach DM + prioritization rubric (due Mon)
- Maya: coord Ops + finalize wave schedule (due Mon)
Ken Cho: I'll start outreach list — pinging a few accounts now. :rocket:
Sonia Rivera: Also flagged: we should capture video demos from 3 partners for case studies. low-effort screen recordings work.
BetaBot: Reminder: calendar slots auto-created for weekly check-ins (5 events) — invite lines up with participants.
Maya Patel: Great — if there are no objections I'll send invites tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
Jordan Li: No objections from me.
Sonia Rivera: Go ahead.
Ken Cho: Go for it.
